note: The new unique constraint on Lower(email) fails on older rows that differ only by case, so web crash-looped during the deploy until the workflow rolled back; the probe already sees the previous image healthy again.

cause.title: fix: allow one account per email address regardless of case
cause.author: Philipp Klinger

cause.body:
Registration and login ignore case since the last fix, but the database still
accepted two rows that differ only by case. A unique constraint on
Lower(email) closes that gap in the database itself.
